name: SMSGateway MSG91
description: Integrates the MSG91 SMS API as an SMS Framework gateway plugin, with a settings form, a send-test form, email-template entities and ECA/Action send actions.
project_description:
This module provides integration Drupal ^9 features with the SMS Gateway MSG91 available in India. It works with SMS Framework and ECA modules.

 Features 
 The module provides ability to add SMS Templates as required by Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) and uses the template IDs while sending the SMSs.

 Post-Installation 
 Configurations are available under configurations/SMSGateway/MSG91. Once installed you will need to add the AuthURL and AuthKey as provided by MSG91. You will also need to add templates manually as registered on the MSG91 portal.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires SMS Framework, Token and ECA

 Similar projects 
 This module is similar to MSG91 SMS . Which is compatible upto Drupal 7

 Supporting this Module 
 This module is supported by the International Union Against TB and Lung Diseases ( The Union )
